$comment: Machine-readable form of the SPEC 6.8.2 function whitelist and the SPEC 6.7 step shapes. Generated by hand from SPEC.md and kept in lockstep with it. Arity is not stored: it is `params`, counted. A `rest` parameter takes one or more arguments, or a single list, so it contributes a minimum of one and no maximum.

functions.name: ceil
functions.summary: Smallest integer greater than or equal to `x`

functions.name: floor
functions.summary: Largest integer less than or equal to `x`

functions.name: round
functions.summary: Nearest integer, halves away from zero

params.name: exponent
params.summary: The power to raise it to

functions.name: min

params.name: value
params.summary: Numbers or dates, or one list of them

functions.summary: Smallest argument; nulls are skipped, never smallest

functions.name: max

params.name: value
params.summary: Numbers or dates, or one list of them

functions.summary: Largest argument; nulls are skipped, never largest

functions.name: mode
functions.summary: Most frequent value; ties go to the one seen first

functions.name: variance
functions.summary: Sample variance (n − 1); fewer than two values is null

functions.name: count
functions.summary: How many values are not null

functions.name: len
functions.summary: Length in code points, or number of items

params.name: separator
params.summary: An empty separator splits into characters

params.name: start
params.summary: In code points; negative counts from the end

params.name: length
params.summary: To the end of `text` when omitted

params.name: width
params.summary: In code points; negative pads on the right

functions.name: year
functions.summary: Calendar year, in the document timezone

functions.name: week
functions.summary: ISO 8601 week number, in the document timezone

functions.name: day
functions.summary: Day of the month, in the document timezone

functions.name: dayOfWeek
functions.summary: `0` Sunday through `6` Saturday, in the document timezone

params.name: amount
params.summary: A whole number of `unit`; may be negative

functions.name: dateTrunc
functions.summary: `date` floored to the start of its `unit`

functions.name: now
functions.summary: The document's build time, never a per-call clock read

functions.name: if
functions.summary: Both branches are evaluated; MDVX has no side effects

functions.name: coalesce
functions.summary: First argument that is not null

functions.name: toNumber
functions.summary: Parsed number, or null — an explicit conversion, so SPEC 6.8.3 does not apply

functions.name: toString
functions.summary: The document's default rendering of `value`; a list is null

params.name: spec
params.summary: A SPEC 6.9 format string; the document's default when omitted

steps.name: filter
steps.summary: Keeps rows where the expression is truthy; null is false

steps.name: derive
steps.shape: a map of field name to expression
steps.summary: Adds or replaces fields, evaluated in order; later entries see earlier ones

steps.name: aggregate
steps.summary: Groups rows and reduces each group

keys.name: group
keys.summary: Field or list of fields to group by; the whole table when omitted

keys.name: sum
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: mean
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: median
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: min
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: max
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: count
keys.summary: `true`, or the output field name

keys.name: first
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: last
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

keys.name: stddev
keys.summary: Field list, or a map of output name to input field

steps.name: sort
steps.shape: a field name or a list of them
steps.summary: Stable sort; a `-` prefix is descending, and nulls sort last

keys.name: n
keys.summary: How many rows to keep

keys.name: offset
keys.summary: How many rows to skip first

steps.name: pivot
steps.summary: Long to wide; new field names come from `key`'s values, sorted for determinism

keys.name: key
keys.summary: Field whose values become the new field names

keys.name: value
keys.summary: Field the new fields are filled from

keys.name: group
keys.summary: Field or list of fields identifying a row

keys.name: fields
keys.summary: The fields to fold into rows

keys.name: key
keys.summary: Name of the field holding the old field name; defaults to `key`

keys.name: value
keys.summary: Name of the field holding the value; defaults to `value`

keys.name: field
keys.summary: The field to bin

keys.name: step
keys.summary: Bin width; wins over `count`

keys.name: count
keys.summary: How many bins to divide the range into

keys.name: output
keys.summary: Name of the field the bin is written to

steps.name: window
steps.summary: Windowed aggregate over the current row order

keys.name: op
keys.summary: `sum`, `mean`, `min`, `max`, `count`, `cumsum`, `delta`, `pct_change`, `rank`, `lag`, or `lead`

keys.name: field
keys.summary: The field to read

keys.name: size
keys.summary: Window width, in rows

keys.name: output
keys.summary: Name of the field the result is written to

keys.name: partition
keys.summary: Field or list of fields the window restarts on

keys.name: with
keys.summary: A `@name` dataset reference

keys.name: on
keys.summary: A field name, or `{left, right}`

keys.name: how
keys.summary: `inner` or `left`; defaults to `left`

steps.name: rename
steps.shape: a map of old name to new name
